summary: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, to announce its fiscal fourth quarter and full-year 2026 financial results (Item 2.02) and to provide notice of its upcoming first annual meeting of stockholders on September 1, 2026, along with advance notice deadlines for director nominations and proposals (Item 8.01). The press release also references a bolt-on acquisition of Reliant Asset Management, but no specific terms (price, premium, advisors) are disclosed. This filing is primarily a routine earnings release and meeting notice, not a special-situation event. The acquisition mention lacks sufficient detail for classification as a standalone special situation.
